name: Landmine Row
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell and stand over the bar, straddling it with a V-handle or both hands gripping the bar end.
Hinge forward with a flat back and your knees slightly bent.
Row the handle toward your chest, driving your elbows back.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.
image_prompt_scene: Straddling a landmine bar, hinged forward with the hands on the handle and the arms extended.
